name: ADX
description: This keyword returns the Average Directional Index (ADX) indicator value of the selected Instrument for the selected timeframe. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Average Directional Index (ADX) indicator value of the selected Instrument for the selected timeframe. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword.

![Example](./images/img-1632223634.png)

The above keyword will return the previous day ADX value of ABFRL

ADX is used to quantify trend strength. ADX calculations are based on a moving average of price range expansion over a given period of time

Read more about ADX here -  https://www.investopedia.com/articles/trading/07/adx-trend-indicator.asp
